step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the client’s account information was valid when the payment was issued:

ul.li: If no, go to Replacing a payment . Replacing a payment

step.cmd: In SPS, verify the date the payment was issued:

ul.li: If 5 business days or less have passed since the payment was issued, go to step 9.
If more than 5 business days have passed since the payment was issued, go to step 10.

step.cmd: Inform the client that if the payment has not been received by [payment issue date + 5 business days], the client must contact the call centre and submit a replacement request. Go to step 11.
Ask if the client has contacted the financial institution about the missing payment:

ul.li: If yes, go to Replacing a payment . Replacing a payment

If no, advise the client to contact the financial institution regarding the missing payment and if a replacement is still required, to contact the call centre to submit a payment replacement request. Go to step 11.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li:
Details: Type the appropriate option:
“On [payment issue date + 5 business days], the client was asked to submit a new replacement request if the payment [payment number] issued on [payment issue date] for the weeks of [YYYY-MM-DD] to [YYYY-MM-DD] was not received.”
“The client was instructed to contact the financial institution about the missing direct deposit payment [payment number] issued on [payment issue date] for the weeks of [YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD]. Then, if the replacement is still necessary, the client must contact the Service Canada Centre to submit a payment replacement request.”
Select Save and go to Completing the WI . Completing the WI
